rationale: Empirical cross-sectional US equity paper (Asness, Frazzini, Pedersen 2019, RAST) using CRSP and Compustat North America. Methodology: construct composite quality score from 16+ sub-variables across Profitability (GPOA, ROE, ROA, CFOA, GMAR, ACC), Growth (5-year growth in residual per-share profitability), and Safety (BAB beta, leverage, O-Score, Z-Score, earnings volatility). Sort stocks into 10 quality deciles (VW, NYSE breakpoints) and 2x3 size-quality portfolios for QMJ factor. Compute excess returns and CAPM/FF3/FF4 alphas. US long sample 7/1957-12/2016 with ~54,616 stocks across 24 countries; US replication tractable with CRSP+Compustat. Detailed variable definitions in Appendix 1 (Compustat item names provided). Multiple tables with concrete numerical targets: Table 3 (decile returns, e.g. P10-P1 excess return = 0.42%, 4-factor alpha H-L = 1.05%), Table 4 (QMJ 4-factor alpha = 0.60% with t=9.95), Table 9 (SMB/HML/UMD spanning tests with QMJ). Data sources verified in ClickHouse: crsp_202601 (dsf, msf, dsenames, dsedelist, dsi, ccmxpf_linktable), comp_202601 (funda, fundq), ff (four_factor_monthly, five_factor_monthly).
